_about: Maps each ground-truth pathway (section.pathway in final_ground_truth.json) to atlas rules (causal_graph.json ids; present if any is triggered) and a Signal_Verification pattern (sheet_rules.json id). Opportunities are left out of stress pathways. Edit this file to change the mapping.

agriculture.groundwater.label: Groundwater
agriculture.groundwater.note: groundwater.recharge_opportunity is an opportunity and is left out

agriculture.low_yield.label: Low yield
agriculture.low_yield.note: productivity.rice_fallow_opportunity is an opportunity and is left out

livelihood.livestock_decline.label: Livestock decline (fodder shortage)
livelihood.livestock_decline.note: ground-truth 'livestock_decline' is read as fodder shortage

socio-economic.caste.label: Multi-sector vulnerability (caste)
socio-economic.caste.note: ground-truth 'caste' is read as multi-sector vulnerability (sheet) and multidimensional_vulnerability (atlas)

socio-economic.health.label: Health
socio-economic.health.note: assumed to be the sheet's Socio-economic / Health pattern
